insertedAt.description: The ISO8601 timestamp at which the setup was created.

updatedAt.description: The ISO8601 timestamp at which the setup was last updated.

deletedAt.description: The ISO8601 timestamp at which the setup was deleted, if at it was.

colorDepth.description: The number of bits per pixel of the display.

rotation.description: The rotation of the display in degrees.

scaleFactor.description: The scale factor of the display.

touchSupport.description: The touch support of the display.

state.description: The type-specific state of the window.

displayId.description: The display ID where the window is located.

isMaximized.description: Whether or not the window is maximized.

isFullScreen.description: Whether or not the window is full screen.

isAlwaysOnTop.description: Whether or not the window is always on top.

maintainAspectRatio.description: Maintain the aspect ratio of the window when resizing.

x.description: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle.

y.description: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle.

streamData.description: The stream data for the player (to match the player to a stream).

driverData.description: The driver data for the player (to match the player to a stream).

F1TVPlayerWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1TV Player.

carNumber.description: The car number of the player.

muted.description: Whether or not the player should be muted by default.

volume.description: The initial volume of the player, float between 0-100.

audioLanguage.description: The audio language of the player.

videoQuality.description: The preferred playback resolution of the player.

mediaSink.description: The preferred media sink (audio output) to use for playback.

title.description: The title of the stream to match the right stream for this window.

type.description: The type of the stream to match the right stream for this window.

contentId.description: The contentId of the content container this stream is part of.

channelId.description: The channelId of the stream to match the right stream for this window.

manifestV2.description: Whether this stream was using a v2 manifest or not.

meetingKey.description: The `meetingKey` from the session where this setup originated from (not used for setup purposes).

sessionKey.description: The `sessionKey` from the session where this setup originated from (not used for setup purposes).

sessionType.description: The `sessionType` from the session where this setup originated from (not used for setup purposes).

StreamData.description: The stream data for the player (to match the player to a stream).

driverNumber.description: The racing number of the driver to match the right stream for this window.

firstName.description: The first name of the driver, for reference only.

lastName.description: The last name of the driver, for reference only.

teamName.description: The team name of the driver, for reference only.

tla.description: The TLA (Three Letter Acronym) of the driver, to match the right stream for this window.

DriverData.description: The driver data for the player (to match the player to a stream).

bitrate.description: The bitrate of the video stream in bits per second.

width.description: The width of the video frame in pixels.

height.description: The height of the video frame in pixels.

VideoQuality.description: The preferred playback resolution of the player.

mediaSinkId.description: The ID of the media sink.

label.description: The label of the media sink.

MediaSink.description: The preferred media sink (audio output) to use for playback.

F1LiveTimingIndexWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Index.

rotationOverride.description: Rotation override for the track map, in degrees. Replaces the circuit's default rotation for this window only.

F1LiveTimingTrackMapWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Track Map.

baselineDriverNumber.description: Racing number of the baseline driver for the "delta to driver" projection. Their line sits flat at zero and every other driver is measured against them. Only used when projectionType is "delta-to-driver".

F1LiveTimingRaceTraceWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Race Trace.

clockwise.description: Spin direction for this window. Overrides the global default, so two windows can spin opposite ways.

referenceDriver.description: Racing number of the reference driver. Gaps are shown relative to this driver; unset means relative to the leader.

gapMode.description: Which gap each chip shows. "leader" measures every car against the classification leader, "ahead" measures the on-track gap to the car ahead. A reference driver overrides both.

F1LiveTimingCircleOfDoomWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Circle of Doom.

filterDriverNumbers.description: Racing numbers this window's radio transcriptions are filtered to. Empty or unset shows every driver, so two popouts can each follow a different driver off the one shared connection. Unset seeds from the global default.

F1LiveTimingRadioTranscriptionsWindowSta.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Radio Transcriptions.

filterTypes.description: Message groups this window's race control feed is filtered to. Empty or unset shows every message, so two popouts can each show a different set off the one shared connection. Unset seeds from the global default.

F1LiveTimingRaceControlWindowState.description: The state of the window for F1 Live Timing Race Control.
